data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an opening gross claims outstanding balance of GBP 686.712m at 1 January 2020. A reassessment of claims outstanding on underwriting years 2017 and prior produced a gross improvement (release) of GBP 25.0m, equivalent to approximately a 3.6% release on opening gross reserves. The improvement is attributed to favourable claims development on back years. Offsetting adverse developments during the period included increases in reserves for specific large losses such as the Boeing MAX 8 liability (reserve increased to GBP 32.6m gross), the Golden Ray marine loss (incurred GBP 8.7m), and late-2019 Chile riots (reserves stated at ~$7m). COVID-19 and 2020 catastrophe activity (notably Hurricane Laura and the Nashville tornado) materially affected 2020 results but are primarily current-year impacts.

Hurricane Laura has contributed 3% to the net loss ratio and has mainly affected the Property Direct USA class.
At 31 December 2020 our gross and net loss estimates for COVID-19, on an ultimate basis, stand at $80m and $75m respectively.
